tasks.short: Issue wooden casting patterns to designated operators

steps.what: Read the actual designated machine operator's casting job request and locate the corresponding unit or sectional wooden pattern references
Inspect the actual wooden casting pattern and verify its identifier, revision and completeness of sectional pieces against the requested job
inputs: actual wooden unit or sectional pattern
outputs: exact complete casting pattern selected for issue

steps.what: Confirm that the exact selected casting pattern and its sectional pieces match the designated operator's actual current job
inputs: exact complete casting pattern selected for issue
outputs: recipient confirmation for exact pattern issue

steps.what: Issue the actual complete wooden pattern physically to the designated machine operator and clarify identification of its sections
inputs: exact complete casting pattern selected for issue
recipient confirmation for exact pattern issue
outputs: actual casting pattern issued to designated operator

tasks.design: Link the actual casting-job reference to the unit or sectional pattern references in {OTHER}, the shop's pattern job and location index, and {DOCS}. The patternmaker and designated operator retain physical identification, section completeness checks and the actual issue.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding all references for a sectional casting pattern can require separate index navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native job-to-pattern links can remove reference navigation without selecting or moving the physical pieces.
tasks.still_hard: A correct main pattern with a missing or wrong sectional piece can be unsuitable for the job.
tasks.human_edge: The patternmaker recognizes the complete physical pattern and the operator confirms its intended use.

ambition.what: No automated pattern transfer or molding-machine operation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: casting-job-to-pattern links can shorten reference navigation while actual sectional-pattern completeness and issue remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is actual physical issue to the designated operator. No trailing issue report or custody entry is added where the shop does not actually keep or use one; any real custody record must be mapped separately rather than hidden in physical issue.
s1 counts reading the real job request and checking reference identity. s2 counts actual piece identification, revision and completeness checks; no free clean physical-pattern feed is assumed.
The link removes2 of25 reference-navigation units and retains23 for actual request and reference checks. Test current native job links first; existing retrieval support earns zero new gain.

s3 is the actual recipient's current-job confirmation, not a new supervisor review or author approval of paperwork. The exact complete pattern exists before confirmation; changed pieces, revision or job void a1.

The actual issue40 and physical verification30 remain full. No software save or machine runtime is priced as a saving. Actual machine setup/control is separate work requiring its actual authority. Shares are unmeasured episode estimates.
unknowns: Whether a real custody record is kept
research_questions: Does the casting-job link remove real repeated index searches without changing physical completeness checks?

already_counted.description: Actual request/reference checks, complete physical pattern verification and human issue remain counted.
Actual recipient's current-job confirmation remains outside focal labour.

incremental.description: Maintain casting-job and sectional-pattern reference links.

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete unit or sectional pattern selected and checked in s2, confirmed for the actual recipient job in s3; changed pieces, revision or job void confirmation.
